[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]

== Biography ==
Katherine was born before 1575. She is the daughter of [[Glasgow-3181|John Glasgow]] and [[Hutcheson-1656|Margaret Hutcheson]].<ref> National Records of Scotland, Edinburgh Commissary Court, CC8/8/5, Image 276 and upper portion of Image 277, testament dative and inventory of Johne Glasgw in Hirmanscheillis; court record dated 1577. </ref>

== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-3181]] is assessed at 99% (proved). John’s 1577 testament names Katherine and Marjory as his lawful children and executors-dative. The named lawful child and executor clause directly establishes this Katherine’s father. The record-defined John is securely identified by the same estate.

Confident for the daughter; the wage-creditor Katherine need not be the same person, and maternity is not inferred from the uncertain pronoun.

Next useful test: Keep the daughter and servant clauses separate when checking the manuscript.

Source basis already held: [https://www.wikitree.com/wiki/Glasgow-3590 National Records of Scotland, Edinburgh Commissary Court, CC8/8/5, Image 276 and upper portion of Image 277, testament dative and inventory of Johne Glasgw in Hirmanscheillis; court record dated 1577.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
